data.name: AbsolutePathRequired
data.value: Local acceptance requires the explicitly configured absolute artifact/results path. Rebuild the test project with AotDllPath.

data.name: RelativePathRequired
data.value: Sandbox acceptance requires a relative path contained within the test application directory. Rebuild with ComAcceptanceSandbox=true.

data.name: InvalidNativeIdentity
data.value: The artifact must be a matching-architecture native PE and its SHA256 must match the packaged official publication.

data.name: ExitArguments
data.value: Expected root seconds filter, or --full root seconds. Root and filtered expressions must not be blank.

data.name: ExitBudget
data.value: The supervision budget must be 1–120 seconds for filtered mode or 1–1500 seconds for full mode.

data.name: DirectConsumerContract
data.value: Direct consumer requires three independent red, blue and green submissions, one exact window DC observation per submission, and complete resource cleanup.

data.name: DirectConsumerClearContract
data.value: Official same-target independent opaque green clear must match one exact window DC observation before binding image content and submitting red once. At most two observations; clear may warm the hardware device and alter interop frontbuffer conditions. This is not product acceptance.

data.name: PartitionIsolationContract
data.value: Asynchronous partition isolation requires successful legal setup, exact shared partition failure 0x88980406, continued independent updates before and after closing failed channels, verified actual module identity, and complete cleanup. Inspect the raw partition isolation report.

data.name: PostFailureAttachContract
data.value: Post-failure attach requires successful creation of a late shared channel after confirmed asynchronous failure, persistent 0x88980406 before and after source destruction, verified actual module identity, and complete known-object cleanup without unknown registrations. Inspect the raw post-failure attach report.

data.name: NativeObservationContract
data.value: Native observation object/DC contract could not be established. Inspect the exact API results in Results/native-observation-contract.jsonl; this does not establish a general lack of Windows management capabilities.

data.name: OriginalPresentTraceContract
data.value: Original Present raw ETL diagnostics require a unique scope and SDK-compatible controller layout. Raw ETL is not proof of presentation; inspect controller.json and independent cleanup/API results.

data.name: ResourceTrendOptIn
data.value: Resource lifecycle diagnostics require WPFGFX_RESOURCE_TREND=async-shared-wic-v1 and the explicit diagnostic configuration.

data.name: ResourceTrendRole
data.value: Resource lifecycle diagnostics require an original or candidate role.

data.name: ExclusiveForegroundPrerequisite
data.value: FailedNotTriggered: exclusive foreground prerequisite failed. Inspect DeviceLossForeground API BOOL, owner PID and session; no real device loss is claimed.
